phase: Contextual Insurance Quote Acquisition Entry Points
objective: Make the existing public insurance quote request surface discoverable from high-intent insurance education contexts without turning the global editorial navigation into a sales funnel.

architecture.guidePolicy: No edits to individual insurance handbook body content or shared handbook renderer
